tickerText: [TENNIS] Thursday at the indoor ATP 500s: Alexander Zverev can clinch No. 1 with a win over Tallon Griekspoor as Carlos Alcaraz faces Nikoloz Basilashvili and Daniil Medvedev opens against Cameron Norrie in Vienna; in Basel, Novak Djokovic meets Jan-Lennard Struff, Taylor Fritz plays Denis Shapovalov and Ben Shelton faces wild card Jerome Kym • [SQUASH] Semifinal day at Brookfield Place in Toronto as the Canadian Women's Open reaches the penultimate round after Fayrouz Aboelkheir advanced when Anahat Singh withdrew injured, with Tinne Gilis, Nada Abbas, Farida Mohamed and Georgina Kennedy among Thursday's last-four hopefuls • [BADMINTON] HYLO Open round of 16 Thursday in Saarbrücken sets up an all-Indian men's singles clash between Kiran George and Lakshya Sen after George beat June Wei Cheam, while Toma Popov ousted H. S. Prannoy and the Super 500 field plays singles and doubles across three courts • [PICKLEBALL] Opendoor Pickleball World Championships week opens Friday in Farmers Branch, Texas, with the inaugural MLP Nations Cup on Halloween weekend before the Carvana PPA Tour major runs Nov. 2–8 at Brookhaven Country Club • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Montpellier's Thursday slate sees Hiroto Shinozuka past Hugo Calderano, Jang Woo-jin edge Lin Yun-Ju in five and Sora Matsushima through to face Vladimir Sidorenko as Patrick Franziska and Truls Möregårdh also advance at Sud de France Arena

newsItems.title: Vienna & Basel Thursday
newsItems.excerpt: Zverev can reach No. 1 against Griekspoor as Alcaraz and Medvedev headline Vienna; Djokovic, Fritz and Shelton lead Basel's Thursday card.

newsItems.title: Toronto Semifinals
newsItems.excerpt: The Canadian Women's Open hits semifinal day at Brookfield Place after Aboelkheir reached the last four when Singh withdrew with an injury.

newsItems.title: Worlds Week Ahead
newsItems.excerpt: Farmers Branch hosts the MLP Nations Cup from Oct. 30 before the Opendoor PPA major (Nov. 2–8) brings the tour's biggest ranking points payout.

newsItems.title: Montpellier Round of 32
newsItems.excerpt: Shinozuka beat Calderano, Jang outlasted Lin Yun-Ju in five and Matsushima advanced as WTT Champions Montpellier's men's last-32 continued Thursday.
